Font decisions

Each card is one kind of element on the site. Every look it has today is a row with a picture. Under each row, click the size it should have (the sizes offered are the ones already used for this element), or type your own. Line height and weight work the same way. Looks that end up identical merge, and the line at the bottom of the card shows what is left. A look you do not touch stays as it is.
